image_description: A close-up shot of two musicians, a man in the background and a woman in the foreground, playing bassoons. The focus is on the upper section of the instruments, showing the dark reddish-brown wooden bodies, the silver metal keys, and the long curved metal bocals inserted into the players' mouths. The lighting is warm and indoor.
